# Alka Traders — Full Company Profile

## About Alka Traders

Alka Traders is a globally connected marine and industrial equipment supplier based in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. Founded in 1990, the company specializes in sourcing and supplying OEM spares, surplus machinery, electrical automation components, hydraulic systems, and emergency procurement parts for the maritime and industrial sectors.

The company operates from its headquarters:
- **Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India** — PLOT - 7 ALANG HOUSE, MOTITALAV ROAD, KHUMBHARWADA, BHAVNAGAR-364001

## What We Sell

Alka Traders supplies 200+ product lines across 19 categories:

### Marine Equipment
- GPS Navigation Systems (e.g., ABB Marine GPS Navigator)
- VHF Marine Radios (e.g., Siemens VHF-7800)
- Radar Antenna Units (e.g., Honeywell RAD-ANT-220)
- ECDIS Navigation Displays (e.g., ABB ECDIS-9600)
- Marine Diesel Engine Sensors
- Lifeboat Release Mechanisms
- Anchor Windlass Motors
- Bilge Water Separators
- Marine Fire Detection Systems
- Hatch Cover Hydraulic Cylinders
- Marine Ballast Pumps
- Steering Gear Actuators
- Marine Alarm Monitoring Systems
- Marine Exhaust Gas Monitors
- Bow Thruster Control Panels

### Electrical Automation
- Variable Speed Drives (ABB ACS880, ACS580)
- PLC CPU Modules (Siemens S7-1500)
- Contactors (Schneider LC1D40)
- Circuit Breakers (MCCB, ACB)
- Frequency Inverters

### Hydraulic Systems
- Axial Piston Pumps (Bosch Rexroth A10VSO)
- Hydraulic Cylinders (Parker HCR series)
- Hydraulic Motors
- Steering Gear Actuators

### Pneumatic Systems
- Pneumatic Cylinders (Festo DSBC series)
- Air Solenoid Valves (SMC VFA series)

### Industrial Spare Parts
- 3-Phase Induction Motors (ABB M3AA series)
- Deep Groove Ball Bearings (SKF 6205)
- Flexible Couplings
- Inductive Proximity Sensors (IFM)
- Industrial Encoders

### Surplus Inventory
- Unused VFDs and drives
- Refurbished industrial equipment

### Lifting & Handling
- Overhead Bridge Cranes (up to 50 ton)
- Electric Hoists (Demag, Kito)
- Wire Rope Slings (Crosby)
- Chain Blocks (Toyota, Southworth)

### Tools & Equipment
- Industrial Heat Guns (Bosch)
- Power Tools (Makita, DeWalt)
- Measurement Instruments (Fluke, Flir)

### Safety Equipment
- Full Body Fall Arrest Harnesses
- Fire Extinguishers (Amerex)
- Hard Hats & Safety Helmets (MSA, Uvex)
- Welding Helmets (Optrel)

## Industries We Serve

1. **Marine Shipping** — Vessel fleet operators, ship managers, chief engineers
2. **Shipyards & Drydocks** — Repair facilities, drydock projects
3. **Oil & Gas** — Upstream/downstream operators, offshore platforms
4. **Power Generation** — Power plant procurement teams
5. **Manufacturing** — Production line managers, MRO teams
6. **Chemical Processing** — Plant procurement, compliance teams

## Ordering Process

1. Browse products at https://alkatraders.co/products or https://alkatraders.co/shop
2. Add items to cart and checkout, or submit a Request for Quote (RFQ)
3. For emergency parts, call +91 87990 95041 or use WhatsApp for instant response
4. Payment accepted via PayPal, bank transfer, and wire transfer
5. Shipping via FedEx, DHL, and local carriers with tracking
